title: hieracium maculatum subsp. divisum
intro: Hieracium maculatum subsp. divisum, commonly known as a species of hawkweed, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and antioxidant properties, making it a valuable remedy for various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium maculatum subsp. divisum include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which can aid in wound healing, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
